intro.fr: A Difficult Game About Climbing se joue en multiworld Archipelago grâce à un APWorld communautaire, distribué hors de l'installation officielle.
intro.en: A Difficult Game About Climbing can be played in an Archipelago multiworld through a community APWorld, distributed outside the official install.

text.fr: Création du dépôt GitHub BlastSlimey/GrabbingChecks, qui héberge l'APWorld de A Difficult Game About Climbing.
text.en: The GitHub repository BlastSlimey/GrabbingChecks, home of the A Difficult Game About Climbing APWorld, is created.

text.fr: Publication de la version 0.1.2, la plus récente au 21 octobre 2026 (3 versions publiées).
text.en: Version 0.1.2 is released, the latest as of October 21, 2026 (3 versions released).

text.fr: A Difficult Game About Climbing figure dans le tableur communautaire des APWorlds, qui recense les mondes jouables hors de l'installation officielle d'Archipelago.
text.en: A Difficult Game About Climbing is listed in the community APWorlds spreadsheet, which tracks the worlds playable outside the official Archipelago install.
